title: Compensation.
bodyText: The members shall serve without compensation but shall be reimbursed for their necessary expenses in attending meetings of the commission and in the discharge of their duties.
bodyHtml: [§367-2.3]  Compensation.  The members shall serve without compensation but shall be reimbursed for their necessary expenses in attending meetings of the commission and in the discharge of their duties. [L 1991, c 46, §1]
